sentences.en: Juha walked in the market in the morning.

sentences.ar: הוא ראה שק גדול של בצל.
sentences.en: He saw a big sack of onions.

sentences.ar: אשתו שאלה: מה נעשה עם זה?
sentences.en: His wife asked: what shall we do with this?
He said: we shall sell in the village at a high price.
She said: in the village there are onions.
He took the sack to the village.
Not one man bought from him.
In the evening he came back with the sack.
His wife asked: so what now?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אני חושב על זה.
sentences.en: Juha said: I am thinking about it.
He said: we shall eat onions.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל יום, עד הסוף.
sentences.en: He said: every day, until the end.
She said: is that your plan?
